I couldn't use the private note I'd saved in gbrain. When I tried to read it, gbrain refused and returned nothing. This brain serves several people, and this connection isn't tied to any one member, so it won't read for anyone. Instead I read the date from Pree's own message in our DM, which she can see herself.

To fix gbrain recall, an admin needs to run this on the machine that hosts the brain: `gbrain auth rescope --token <token> --member '<member>'`. That ties the connection to one member, so it only reads what that person may read. They can check the result afterwards with `gbrain access check`.
